question: Does the common UI host (manager/target/canopus_ui_host.c, ADR-CAN-010) work on a real Xiaomi Band 10 Pro, firmware 3.101.043: Manager pages, module pages, controls, dialogs and title back?
callsite_evidence: The maintainer ran the build with the common UI host on a real Xiaomi Band 10 Pro, firmware 3.101.043 and reported on 2026-10-19 that it works as it did in the Mirage runs (scripts/emu/ui_pages.py): Manager overview, modules, module detail, module pages from ui-demo and ui-gallery with their form controls, progress bar, text, image, dialog and title back.
The symbols listed are exactly the firmware entry points manager/target/canopus_ui_host.c and the page routing of manager/target/canopus_manager_target.c call on this target.
ownership_analysis: Unchanged from the static records: firmware widgets are page-owned and used only from the page owner (UI) task by the Supervisor's Manager; no module can reach these entries (policy stays restricted).
unsafe_assumptions: This is the maintainer's report of an on-device run. No log, probe output or screenshot is stored in the repository, so it is a report, not a reproducible capture.
It covers the UI host paths named above on this exact firmware only; other targets, the Supervisor install path and unregistration lifetime are not covered.
recommended_probe: Keep a device log or screen recording of the Manager and ui-gallery run with the next device test, and attach its hash here.

artifacts.role: the emulator scenario the device run repeated
